Musashi Seimitsu.why: Its Energy Solution business (Musashi Energy Solutions) makes Hybrid SuperCapacitors (HSC) that absorb the steep power fluctuations of AI data-center clusters; it is expanding HSC capacity (Hokuto Plant expansion, new Minami-Alps Plant handed over June 2026) to meet that demand, so AI data-center power build-outs drive its new growth pillar.
Musashi Seimitsu.evidence: Musashi Seimitsu results presentation: FY2026 First Quarter (08-06-2026): 'HSC: key infrastructure for power quality in AI data centers'; 'Yamanashi Hokuto Plant: capacity expansion underway / Yamanashi Minami-Alps Plant: handover in June 2026 ... Strengthening production capability to meet robust demand'.

players.product: Hybrid SuperCapacitor (HSC) (Musashi Energy Solutions) for AI data-center power peak shaving

quarterly_data.quarter: Musashi Seimitsu annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Energy Solution business (annual securities report): the company is developing the Energy Solution business centred on the hybrid supercapacitor (HSC) that supports AI data centers into a new growth pillar. Management says HSC's high input / output and long life are highly valued for the complex, large power loads specific to AI data centers, with tighter regulation for power-supply stabilisation a tailwind; in response to rapidly growing AI data-center demand it is strengthening HSC supply - expanding capacity at the Hokuto Plant (Yamanashi) and building a new plant in Minami-Alps City, preparing for start of operation - to meet the full-scale demand increase from 2027 onward. It opened the Austin R&D Center in Texas, USA in December 2025 to accelerate business in North America.
quarterly_data.figure: full-scale HSC demand increase expected from 2027 onward

quarterly_data.quarter: Musashi Seimitsu annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D, fiscal year April 2025-March 2026 (annual securities report): JPY 5,703 million, mainly at the parent, Kyushu Musashi Seimitsu and Musashi Energy Solutions. Energy Solution: completed development of a high-output, high-durability hybrid supercapacitor for AI data centers and brought it to market as a peak-shaving solution; developing next-generation products for the needs of future AI data centers, aimed at the data-center and large commercial mobility markets. Powertrain: expanding high-strength, quiet gears and differentials that help EV power efficiency, further fuel-economy gains for HEV products, and development / production technology for three-wheeler EVs. Linkage & suspension: compact, lightweight, low-friction and high-response products for electrification and autonomous driving. e-Mobility: the two-wheeler EV drive unit (e-Axle) has been mass-produced and sold in India since Musashi's fiscal 2024 (the year from April 2024), with collaboration with local partners begun in Africa; it plans to widen into EV drive systems and services.

quarterly_data.quarter: Musashi Seimitsu annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management's view and priorities (annual securities report): BEV demand growth fell short of initial expectations in major markets including China and Europe, North America swung back from BEV to HEV, and HEV demand stayed firm worldwide. In four-wheel, orders for parts used in BEVs and HEVs were firm, led by its differential (which it calls world top share), and inquiries are rising as customers rebuild production and supply and seek to move to local production; in two-wheel, ICE parts were strong, led by its transmission assembly (world top share), with India growing sharply and more models in India carrying its e-Axle; its Kenya and Ethiopia two-wheeler EV initiative was adopted under a METI Global South program and it began working with a startup in Bangladesh. It expanded orders from local Chinese automakers and decided a structural reform in Europe built on capacity optimisation and site reorganisation (now being executed). Priorities: a stable earnings base across ICE, HEV and BEV powertrains; more orders for high-function ball joints that carry heavy BEV bodies; growth in Southeast Asian and Indian two-wheelers; faster e-Axle production and sales in India and Africa; expanded HEV production in North America; stronger order activity with Chinese domestic automakers.
